notFound: Carlton: no current luggage found for sale in UK, Ireland, US, Canada or Mexico. carltonlondon.co.uk answers 'Unavailable Shop' (a closed Shopify store); Carlton (VIP Industries) trolleys are now sold in India (carltonlondon.co.in, Amazon.in, Nykaa), which is not a game market. UK listings found were only used items on eBay and Gumtree. No products recorded.

Radley: radley.co.uk lists suitcases (Lexington, Lexington Colour, Thrift Floral, Abstract Animal) but every one read on 2026-10-04 was marked unavailable/sold out at clearance prices, so none were recorded. The site's products.json, collection pages and search hide its luggage, so handles were found by web search and read through /products/<handle>.js. Next.co.uk and Very.co.uk (both stock Radley Lexington) returned 403. John Lewis no longer stocks Radley suitcases ('no longer available online'); the one Radley travel bag in stock there (Bramwell Lane weekender) was recorded as secondhand.

Aerolite: aerolite.co.uk blocks all automated reads (Cloudflare 403, including WebFetch). Products were taken from aeroliteluggage.co.uk, which calls itself the 'Official UK Store' but could not be confirmed as the brand's own site, so all are marked secondhand. Luggage sets, laptop bags sold only in twin packs, and sold-out items were left out. No US, Canada or Ireland Aerolite offers were found.

Kono: kono-luggage.co.uk has no shop of its own; it links out to Amazon UK, US, Canada and Australia listings. UK products were taken from Easy Luggage (easyluggage.co.uk), a UK retailer that lists Kono by model code with specs, so all are secondhand; vanity cases, sets, lunch/school/everyday bags and a 20in+12in combo were left out, and four travel backpacks without published dimensions were dropped to stay within 100. Amazon UK withheld every Kono price because the reader's delivery location resolved to the United States ("cannot be dispatched to your selected delivery location"), so no Amazon UK offers were recorded. Four Kono Amazon.com (US) listings resolved with a price and were recorded as separate US products because they could not be matched to a UK model code; Amazon.ca listings returned no available price. konosuitcases.co.uk returned nothing.

John Lewis: johnlewis.com blocks curl (connection refused), so pages were read through WebFetch. Left out as not currently available online: Geneva Large Weekend Holdall and Leather Overnight Holdall Bag (both out of stock online). Some John Lewis spec figures look like packaging data (Cotton Canvas Overnighter 9.3 kg and 67 cm, Leather Weekender 7.6 kg and 68 cm, Vienna garment bag 10x15x45 cm), so those weights and dimensions were set to null; Tulum 'material' was given as 100% polyester (the lining) for a hard-shell case, so it was set to null. John Lewis does not sell into Ireland, the US, Canada or Mexico under its own brand online.

Antler: antler.co.uk (GBP) and antler.com (USD) read in full via Shopify products.json plus each model's page for specs. Multi-piece sets, accessories, totes and cross-body bags were left out. Models whose every colour was sold out (Logo Stripe expandable cabin/medium/large on the UK site, Logo expandable cabin on the UK site) were left out of the UK offers. Antler's 'Lifetime Warranty' cannot be expressed in warrantyYears and is recorded as null. No Antler Ireland, Canada or Mexico storefront was found.

IT Luggage: itluggage.com (GBP) read in full; 'Personalised' duplicates, kids' luggage, vanity cases, washbags and luggage sets were left out, and family-size combinations with every colour sold out were left out. itluggage.com had no Irish or US storefront (/en-ie and /en-us return 404). Lykke Large is published as 44L, which conflicts with its 81x49x30 cm size; recorded as published.

CabinZero: only backpacks are sold (no suitcases or duffels). Classic Tech Backpack 36L and Classic Flight Backpack 12L were sold out in every colour and were left out. cabinzero.us is a parked domain; no US, Canada or Ireland storefront was found (cabinzero.com serves GBP). CabinZero's 'Limited Lifetime Warranty' is recorded as warrantyYears null.

Cabin Max: cabinmax.com (GBP) read in full; sets, packing cubes, toiletry/vanity cases, accessories and the sold-out Vela 24L Cabin Trolley Bag were left out, as were two duplicate listings of the same product (Evosa hybrid trolley, Metz 20L underseat copy). No US, Canada or Ireland storefront was found.
Tripp: tripp.co.uk (GBP) read in full; beauty/vanity cases, packing cubes, luggage tags and a laptop bag were left out. Tripp sells in the UK only.
